finalText:
Found it and fixed it. The build broke at `packages/shared/config.js:15` — it merged package configs with a shallow `Object.assign`, so any package overriding part of `output` or `sourcemap` (like `@acme/api`, `@acme/web`, `@acme/cli`) lost the rest of that nested object, including `output.dir`.

I replaced it with a one-level-deep merge that keeps sibling keys like `dir` when a layer only overrides `format` or `entry`. Build now finishes clean: `0 errors`, and `verify.js` confirms it.
